title: Inclusive whole-number order quantity
request: Create a draft boundary-test design for the stated quantity rule. Do not execute tests, call tools, write to external systems, or report a pass/fail result. Return only the common response envelope.

known_facts.text: Order quantity is a whole number from 1 through 9, inclusive.
Quantity 0 and quantity 10 must be rejected.

scope: Boundary-design draft only; no execution, approval, release, or external write.

checks.question: Provide the accepted and rejected neighbouring quantity candidates as a JSON observation.
Provide the source fact IDs used for the boundary rule as a sorted unique string-set observation.
